body:
This seems to be a caching issue. Are you using the [`cache`](https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-reference/widgets/infinite-hits/react-hooks/#widget-param-cache) prop?

If not, it'd be helpful to get a reproduction in [this sandbox](https://codesandbox.io/s/github/algolia/react-instantsearch/tree/master/examples/hooks?file=/App.tsx).
